summary: Created `desk:apps:temp`; the Celsius converter opens and correctly shows 25°C → 77°F, with decimal entry and Backspace working.

files.desk:apps:temp:
app 'Temperature Converter'
task start()
give ''
done
task key(s, k)
set next to s
when k is 'backspace'
when count(next) > 0
set next to slice(next, 1, count(next) - 1)
done
done
when (is_number(k) or k is '-' or k is '.')
set next to next & k
done
give next
done
task draw(s)
show(1, 1, 'C: ' & s)
when is_number(s)
show(2, 1, 'F: ' & (number(s) * 9 / 5 + 32))
otherwise
show(2, 1, 'F: ?')
done
done
